title: CMB primordial bispectrum fNL constraint row
description: One fNL constraint cell from Planck 2018 IX Table 5. Each row records the foreground-cleaning map (SMICA/SEVEM/NILC/Commander), the data channel (T temperature-only, E E-polarization-only, T+E joint), the template (local/equilateral/orthogonal), the estimator method (KSW/Binned/Modal 1/Modal 2), the lensing-bias subtraction state, and the constraint as fNL_value +/- fNL_error at 68% CL (statistical).

constraint_id.description: Stable identifier for this fNL constraint cell (e.g. 'SMICA_TplusE_local_KSW_lenssub').

cleaning_map.description: Foreground-cleaning pipeline used to generate the CMB map analysed for this constraint. Planck 2018 reports four cleaning maps; SMICA is the map of choice for final results.

channel.description: Data channel: T = temperature-only bispectrum; E = E-mode polarization-only bispectrum; TplusE = joint analysis. T+E is the canonical headline channel for primordial-constraint headlines.

template.description: Bispectrum shape template. 'local' = squeezed-triangle peak (multi-field models); 'equilateral' = equal-mode triangle (single-field models with non-standard interactions); 'orthogonal' = orthogonal to equilateral by construction (EFT P(X,phi) extensions).

method.description: Bispectrum estimator algorithm. KSW = Komatsu-Spergel-Wandelt separable-template estimator (the canonical fiducial method, used in Table 6 headline). Binned = binned-bispectrum estimator. Modal 1 / Modal 2 = orthonormal-mode-decomposition estimators (Modal 2 uses 300 FFP10 sims vs 160 for Modal 1).

lensing_subtracted.description: Whether the predicted lensing-induced bispectrum bias has been subtracted. False = 'Independent' (no subtraction). True = 'Lensing subtracted' (paper canonical: Table 5 right-hand columns; Table 6 final results).

fNL_value.description: Constrained value of the fNL amplitude parameter for this (map, channel, template, method, lensing) combination. Dimensionless. Plotted at 68% CL with statistical (Gaussian) error in the paper.

fNL_error.description: 1-sigma statistical uncertainty on fNL_value (68% CL Gaussian). Does not include systematic uncertainties (foreground residuals, point-source contamination, etc.); the paper Sect. 6 estimates these to be a fraction of the statistical error in most cases.

precision_flag.description: Per-row precision flag. PR3 fNL rows are 'high' (Table 5 values verbatim).

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited Planck reference. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201833881 (Planck 2018 IX).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_file.description: Optional source-paper section/table label (e.g. 'Planck 2018 IX Table 5' or 'Planck 2018 IX Table 6').
